message.content: {"items":[{"item_id":"e011","prompts":["我在做一个六边形地图的游戏，玩家选中的格子坐标是 (3, 5)，我想知道它周围一圈的格子都有哪些，用 offset 坐标表示。","请帮我算一下六边形网格里 (1, 1) 到 (7, 4) 这两个格子之间隔了几个格子。","我有一个棋盘游戏需要判断两个单位在六边形地图上是否相邻，位置分别是 offset 坐标 (2, 3) 和 (3, 4)，帮我判断一下。","帮我写一个函数，输入一个六边形格子的 offset 坐标，返回它距离中心格子 (0, 0) 的距离。","我在设计一个蜂窝状的区域划分，想知道以 (4, 2) 为中心、半径为 2 的范围内包含哪些六边形格子。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e012","prompts":["我有一批 podcast 的 wav 文件，想先做个 energy profile，把每个文件的音量随时间的变化画出来，方便后面做 silence detection。","帮我用 Python 算一段 audio 的 per-second RMS，看看哪些时间段基本没有声音，输出每一秒的能量值。","做语音数据预处理的时候，我想先统计每秒的音量，找出那些长期接近静音的 segment，帮我写个脚本处理这些 mp3。","我需要对比两段录音的响度分布，把每秒的 RMS energy 算出来再画个对比图，文件在 ./audio 目录下。","帮我准备一份音频能量数据，按秒输出 RMS 值，我要拿它来训练一个检测停顿的模型。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e013","prompts":["Review this C++ module I wrote for an OpenHarmony device driver — I want to make sure it follows the project's naming and header conventions before I submit it.","I'm writing a new service component in C++ for an OpenHarmony IoT project; help me structure the classes and files so they comply with the strict conventions, especially around input validation.","Refactor this legacy C++ file so it meets OpenHarmony requirements: fix the raw pointer usage, add proper memory safety checks, and align the formatting with the style guide.","I need a code review checklist applied to my OpenHarmony C++ pull request — focus on security issues like unvalidated input from IPC messages and potential buffer overflows.","Show me how to correctly include and order headers, and name classes and methods, for a new OpenHarmony C++ utility library so it passes the project's strict linting."],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e014","prompts":["我在整理团队的看板，想查一下 project ID 是 PVT_kwDOABC123 的项目里都有哪些字段配置。","帮我看一下 ID 为 PVTI_lADOABCxyz 的那个条目具体内容，包括标题和字段值。","我们有个 GitHub Project 的某个 view，ID 是 PVTL_zzz123，我想确认它现在的过滤条件是什么样的。","请把项目编号 PVT_kwHOBBY42 的基本信息拉出来，我想核对一下它的描述和状态。","帮我通过 ID 获取这个 project item 的详情，看看它关联的是哪个 issue。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e015","prompts":["CI 已经全绿了，帮我把 owner/repo 上那个 PR #482 直接 merge 掉，用 merge commit 的方式。","这个 pull request 两个 reviewer 都 approve 了，帮我执行 squash merge，repo 是 myteam/backend-service，编号 915。","revert PR 已经验证过了，帮我 rebase merge 到 main，仓库 acme/order-service 的 #230。","帮我把 hotfix 的 PR #77 合了，标题前缀自动生成 commit message，仓库 infra/deploy-tools。","PR #330 的检查都通过了，请 merge 并删除对应的 branch，仓库是 datateam/pipeline。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e016","prompts":["One of my own inline comments on PR #312 is outdated after a force push — please minimize it for me, repo is acme/payments.","Please hide the review comment marked as resolved on the diff of pull request #88 in myteam/website, the one about the CSS refactor.","There's a duplicate inline comment thread on our PR diff that I have triage access to; minimize comment id 1902345678 in org/repo.","As the repo maintainer I want to clean up the PR review — collapse that off-topic inline comment on line 42 of the diff for PR #1505.","Minimize my nitpick comment on the pull request diff so it doesn't clutter the review, it's comment node ID PRCC_abc123 in shop/mobile-app."],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e017","prompts":["我这里有某河流断面过去二十年的溶解氧月度监测数据，帮我判断一下是不是存在显著的下降趋势。","帮我分析这份 2010 到 2024 年的城市年均气温序列，看升温趋势在统计上是否显著。","公司过去八年每季度的客户流失率数据在附件里，我想知道流失率是不是真的在逐年上升，还是只是随机波动。","我收集了某站点十年的 PM2.5 日均值，帮我做一个长期趋势检验，最好用不依赖分布假设的方法。","请帮我检验这组传感器读数的时间序列有没有明显的单调变化，数据可能含有季节波动，需要先处理掉。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e018","prompts":["我们的 legacy 服务还停在 Spring Boot 2.7，想升到 3.x，先帮我看看 pom.xml 里哪些 dependency 需要改版本。","升级的时候 javax 的 JAXB 相关依赖一直报错，帮我处理一下 Spring Boot 3 下面的兼容问题。","我想用 OpenRewrite 做自动化迁移，帮我把这个 project 从 Boot 2 迁到 3，顺便列一个 migration checklist。","Java 8 的老项目要迁到 Boot 3，得先升 JDK 17，帮我规划一下升级步骤和可能踩的坑。","帮我把这个 Spring Boot 2.6 的应用升级到 3.2，重点看看 deprecated 的配置和 starter 有哪些要换。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e019","prompts":["Before I search for flights, can you check whether \"Aspen\" is actually a valid city in Colorado, or should I pick another destination in that state?","List the cities in New Mexico so I can decide where to book a hotel for my trip.","I'm not sure which city the user meant by their state input \"TX\" — expand it into a list of destination options I can show them.","Give me all the cities in Alaska that I could suggest for a road trip itinerary.","Validate the state \"Massachusets\" (possible typo) and then show me the cities there so I can pick a restaurant location."],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e020","prompts":["帮我搭一个 Spring Boot 3 的微服务脚手架，要有统一异常处理和参数校验，用 Maven 管理依赖。","我们的订单服务在高并发下查询很慢，帮我优化一下 JPA/Hibernate 这边的懒加载和索引问题。","我想给现有的 REST API 加上认证授权，用 Spring Security 和 JWT，帮我写一套完整的实现。","团队准备把同步接口改造成响应式的，帮我用 WebFlux 重写这个查询接口并说明背压处理。","帮我设计一个 Spring Cloud 的服务注册与配置方案，包括 gateway 和各服务之间的调用链路。"],"rubric":[]}]}
